resources.string: Android as Proxy 2 turns this phone into a SOCKS5 Internet exit over a verified, outbound SSH connection to your own server.
Licensed under GNU GPL v3.0. Source code is available for inspection, modification and redistribution under the license terms.
AAP2 requires an administrator-managed OpenSSH server and a one-time activation code. It is not an instant VPN service.
AAP2 has no advertising, analytics, or account registration. Connection diagnostics remain on this device unless you choose to share a log.
For unattended use, check this phone’s battery optimization and Wi-Fi sleep behavior. Connected means the SSH tunnel is up, not that every Internet destination is reachable.
This F-Droid build receives updates through your F-Droid client; it cannot install GitHub APKs.
This GitHub build can check for a newer stable release using its manual Update button.
